metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Hong Kong decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI data (tropospheric NO2) - Location: Hong Kong (approximately 22.3°N, 114.2°E) - Dates: January 1-20, 2020 (baseline) vs. February 10-25, 2020 (comparison) - Band: 'tropospheric_no2_column_number_density' 2. Masking strategy: - TROPOMI data is processed at source; we should check quality flags but for NO2 column density, we primarily need valid data - We'll filter by QA values if available to ensure data quality - No cloud masking needed as this is satellite column data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null: - Valid NO2: typically 0-2e16 molecules/cm² (reasonable range) - Invalid: None, NaN, or values outside physically plausible range - Compare means: if Feb mean < Jan mean, answer is A (Yes, decreased); otherwise B (No) - Check pixel counts to detect C2 (no valid pixels) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Hong Kong const hongKong = ee.Geometry.Point([114.2, 22.3]); const region = hongKong.buffer(50000); // ~50 km buffer // 2. Define time periods const jan_start = '2020-01-01'; const jan_end = '2020-01-20'; const feb_start = '2020-02-10'; const feb_end = '2020-02-25'; // 3. Acquire TROPOMI NO2 data const s5p = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_L3_NO2'); const janCollection = s5p .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(jan_start, jan_end) .select('tropospheric_no2_column_number_density'); const febCollection = s5p .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(feb_start, feb_end) .select('tropospheric_no2_column_number_density'); // 4. Check collection sizes const janSize = janCollection.size().getInfo(); const febSize = febCollection.size().getInfo(); print(`January 1-20, 2020 Images: ${janSize}`); print(`February 10-25, 2020 Images: ${febSize}`); if (janSize === 0 || febSize === 0) { print('No valid data for one or both periods.'); print('C1'); return; } // 5. Calculate mean NO2 for each period const janMean = janCollection.mean(); const febMean = febCollection.mean(); // 6. Reduce to region and get mean values const janStats = janMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 5600, // TROPOMI resolution maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const febStats = febMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 5600, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const janNO2 = janStats['tropospheric_no2_column_number_density']; const febNO2 = febStats['tropospheric_no2_column_number_density']; // 7. Validation if (janNO2 === null || janNO2 === undefined || isNaN(janNO2) || febNO2 === null || febNO2 === undefined || isNaN(febNO2)) { print('Calculation resulted in invalid values.'); print('C3'); return; } // 8. Check for physically plausible values (NO2 in molecules/cm²) if (janNO2 < 0 || janNO2 > 5e16 || febNO2 < 0 || febNO2 > 5e16) { print('Values outside physically plausible range.'); print('C3'); return; } print(`January Mean NO2: ${janNO2.toExponential(2)} molecules/cm²`); print(`February Mean NO2: ${febNO2.toExponential(2)} molecules/cm²`); print(`Difference (Feb - Jan): ${(febNO2 - janNO2).toExponential(2)}`); print(`Percent Change: ${(((febNO2 - janNO2) / janNO2) * 100).toFixed(1)}%`); // 9. Determine answer if (febNO2 < janNO2) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
